The exact star Lipschitz norm is F_m(s)=(2−4/m)e^(−s)−(1−4/m)e^(-(m+1)s), obtained by a maximizing spoke pattern. Let r→∞, t=s/r for sharpness; positivity of the finite-rim heat kernel obstructs finite-r attainment of the positive-time maximum. Elementary calculus gives s_m, C_m and C_m→2. Independent exact enumeration confirmed 28 sharp spoke derivatives for m=5..11 and tested r. The universal result rests on analytic proof, not 28 instances.
